my brethren, and thy brethren, and let them iudge betwen
me & thee. † Haue I therfore bene with thee twentie yeares? 38
thy ewes and goates were not barren, the wethers of thy
flocke I did not eate : † neyther that which the beaſt had 39
caught did I shew to thee, I made good al the damage:
whatſoeuer peri ſhed by theft, thou dideſt exact it of me :
† day and night was I parched with heate, and with froſt, 40
and ſleepe did flye from myne eyes. † And in this ſorte haue 41
I ſerued thee in thy houſe twentie yeares, fourtene for thy
daughters, and ſix for thy flockes : thou haſt changed alſo
my wages tenne times. † Vnles the God of my father Abra- 42
ham, and the feare of Iſaac had holpe me, peraduenture
now thou haddeſt ſent me away naked : God beheld my
affliction and the laboure of my hands, and rebuked thee
yeſterday: † Laban anſwered him : The daughters are mine 43
and the children, and thy flockes, and al things that thou
ſeeſt are mine : what can I do to my daughters, and ne-
phews? † Come therfore, let vs enter in league : that it44
may be for a teſtimonie betwen me and thee. † Iacob ther- 45
